title: Shared experiment-completeness contract + Z80 six-shard fixture (directive s2A)
objective: A missing, duplicated, substituted or altered shard produces an explicit refusal / INCOMPLETE status, never a smaller experiment.
problem: Build rso/completeness/ (shared, engine-agnostic): a frozen experiment MANIFEST format (expected shard identities; seed / partition assignments; arms; expected execution counts per arm; source + artifact sha256; an optional PREREGISTERED early-stopping rule) and a verifier `verify(manifest, presented_shards) -> COMPLETE | INCOMPLETE(missing) | REFUSED(duplicate / conflicting / substituted / altered / unexpected)` that an analyzer calls BEFORE reading a verdict. A preregistered early stop (declared in the manifest, with its trigger evidence) is distinguishable from unplanned missing evidence. Known-answer fixture: the committed C-017 six shards rso/z80/runs/CONFIRM.{0..5}-6.{jsonl.gz,meta.json} -- derive a manifest from rso/z80/PREREGISTRATION.md s6 + FROZEN.json + the committed metas WITHOUT editing any rso/z80/ file (C-017's frozen result must not change). Tests: the complete set verifies COMPLETE and, fed to the frozen rso.z80.analysis, reproduces CONFIRM.analysis.json exactly; remove one shard -> INCOMPLETE; duplicate one -> REFUSED; substitute a dev or re-run shard with a different rows sha -> REFUSED; alter one row / one meta field -> REFUSED; a shard from another seed partition -> REFUSED; an early stop declared in the manifest -> COMPLETE_EARLY_STOP only with its trigger. A wrapper `python -m rso.completeness.z80 <shards...>` = verify then run the frozen analyzer (a NEW analyzer version; the frozen one is untouched). Registry: propose an entry (stage AUTHOR_TESTED) in your notes; Palamedes owns rso/registry/.
non_goals: No new service or DB schema
evidence_required: tests for every corruption kind on the Z80 fixture

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; committed with source references
